arXiv:2607.13591v1 [cs.CL] 2026 年 7 月 15 日arXiv:2607.13591v1 [cs.CL] 15 Jul 2026

内存作为受控过程：LLM 代理的学习自适应内存管理Memory as a Controlled Process: Learned Adaptive Memory Management for LLM Agents

Eric Hanchen Jiang1*, Zhi Zhang1*, Yuchen Wu2, Levina Li1, Dong Liu1,
Xiao Liang1, Rui Sun1, Yubei Li1, Edward Sun1, Haozheng Luo3,
Zhaolu Kang , Aylin Caliskan2, Kai-Wei Chang1, Ying Nian Wu1†

1University of California Los Angeles, 2University of Washington,
3Northwestern University
摘要Abstract

大型语言模型（LLM）代理越来越依赖外部记忆系统来积累跨任务的经验。然而，几乎所有现有的方法，从图形结构记忆到反思性洞察存储，都是通过Large Language Model (LLM) agents increasingly rely on external memory systems to accumulate experience across tasks. Yet nearly all existing approaches, from graph-structured memories to reflective insight stores, access memory through固定的、手工设计的启发式fixed, hand-designed heuristics。我们认为，这种静态的记忆观是主体学习的核心瓶颈，因为最佳记忆行为从根本上来说是依赖于上下文的。由于内存稀疏，任务的早期阶段可以从最少的检索中受益；重复目标类型受益于计划重用，而不是通用的最近邻查找；陷入困境的代理可以从使用替代查询的重新检索中受益；在长任务流中，内存存储本身必须进行整合和修剪才能保持有用。我们呈现. We argue that this static view of memory is a core bottleneck for agentic learning because optimal memory behavior is fundamentally context-dependent. The early stages of the tasks, benefit from minimal retrieval because memory is sparse; recurring goal types benefit from plan reuse rather than generic nearest-neighbor lookup; stuck agents benefit from re-retrieval with alternative queries; and across long task streams, the memory store itself must be consolidated and pruned to remain useful. We present记忆会议MemCon (内存Mem奥里作为ory as a骗局Controlled Process），一个将内存操作建模为马尔可夫决策过程的框架，并学习自适应决策的在线策略trolled Process), a framework that models memory operations as a Markov Decision Process and learns an online policy that adaptively decides当when, 什么what, 和, and多少how much检索、何时注入精炼计划、何时巩固或忘记。to retrieve, when to inject a distilled plan, and when to consolidate or forget.记忆会议MemCon is 与后端无关backend-agnostic：它包装了任何现有的内存实现，从逐个任务的二进制反馈中学习，无需预训练，也无需额外的 LLM 调用，并使用轻量级表格上下文老虎机和 UCB 探索，在数十个任务中收敛。跨越 6 个基准、3 个代理框架和 3 个 LLM 主干，: it wraps any existing memory implementation, learns from task-by-task binary feedback with no pretraining and no additional LLM calls, and uses a lightweight tabular contextual bandit with UCB exploration that converges within tens of tasks. Across 6 benchmarks, 3 agent frameworks, and 3 LLM backbones,记忆会议MemCon在任务成功率方面始终优于多个内存基准高达 15.2 个百分点，同时将令牌消耗减少 5-20%。我们的代码位于consistently outperforms multiple memory baselines by up to 15.2 points in task success while reducing token consumption by 5–20%. Our code is available athttps://github.com/ericjiang18/MemCon/

1 简介Introduction

作为自主代理部署的大型语言模型 (LLM) 在交互环境、多步骤规划和工具使用方面表现出了卓越的能力Large Language Models (LLMs) deployed as autonomous agents have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in interactive environments, multi-step planning, and tool use[58, 57, 48, 56]。 这一进展的一个关键推动因素是. A critical enabler of this progress is记忆memory，能够存储已解决任务的经验并在未来的任务中检索它们，以便代理可以避免重复过去的错误，重用工作策略，并逐步积累领域知识，而不是从头开始每个情节, the ability to store experiences from solved tasks and retrieve them on future ones, so that an agent can avoid repeating past mistakes, reuse working strategies, and incrementally accumulate domain knowledge rather than starting from scratch on every episode[36, 41, 63, 47, 60].

尽管进展迅速Despite rapid progress in什么what存储（轨迹、反思、见解、技能、图表、潜在标记to store (trajectories, reflections, insights, skills, graphs, latent tokens[60, 34, 35, 5, 53, 36]），大多数现有的内存系统都对待内存), most existing memory systems treat memory访问access作为静态管道：每个步骤使用硬编码调用一次全局检索器as a static pipeline: a single global retriever is called once per step with a hard-coded顶部top-kk、硬编码的图跳跃深度和硬编码的查询模板，并使用相同的配置，无论内存为空还是包含数千条轨迹，无论任务是熟悉的还是新奇的，以及代理是否正在进行或已经执行了五个步骤的相同操作。互补的工作线——最突出的是 MemGPT, a hard-coded graph hop depth, and a hard-coded query template, and uses the same configuration whether memory is empty or contains thousands of trajectories, whether the task is familiar or novel, and whether the agent is progressing or has been executing the same action for five steps. A complementary line of work—most prominently MemGPT[35]- 通过将 LLM 本身提升为内存控制器的角色（分页、制定查询和决定何时调用）来使内存访问具有适应性，但代价是每个内存操作需要额外的 LLM 调用。—makes memory access adaptive by promoting the LLM itself to the role of memory controller (paginating, formulating queries, and deciding when to recall), at the cost of an additional LLM call per memory operation.记忆会议MemCon占据第三个设计点：aoccupies a third design point: a博学但轻量级learned but lightweight控制器是自适应的，无需任何额外的 LLM 调用。 我们证明这个静态管道视图是代理内存系统的基本瓶颈：现有的静态内存系统controller that is adaptive without any extra LLM calls. We show this static-pipeline view is a fundamental bottleneck for agentic memory systems: existing static memory systems要么either检索过于激进（夸大上下文和成本，同时损害简单查询的准确性）retrieve too aggressively (inflating context and cost while hurting accuracy on simple queries)or过于保守（缺少关键的可重用计划和反思），因为任何单一设置都至少针对上述一种制度进行了错误校准。too conservatively (missing key reusable plans and reflections), because any single setting is miscalibrated for at least one of the regimes above.

我们认为有效的代理记忆需要位于存储后端顶部的自适应控制层。具体来说： (一)We argue that effective agent memory requires an adaptive control layer sitting on top of the storage backend. Concretely: (i)早期任务Early tasks应该检索should retrieve少less，因为几乎没有什么有用的经验可以借鉴，而且不加区别的检索只会淡化提示。 (二), because there is little useful experience to draw on and indiscriminate retrieval only dilutes the prompt. (ii)重复目标类型Recurring goal types应该更喜欢should prefer计划重用plan reuse，重放先前成功的精炼的、对象通用的模板，而不是对原始轨迹进行最近邻检索。 (三), replaying a distilled, object-generalized template of a prior success, rather than nearest-neighbor retrieval over raw trajectories. (iii)被困特工Stuck agents重复动作应该触发that repeat actions should trigger重新检索re-retrieval使用替代查询而不是重新读取相同的顶部 -with an alternative query rather than re-reading the same top-kk那已经没有帮助了。 （四）that already failed to help. (iv)长任务流Long task streams要求require巩固与遗忘consolidation and forgetting这样，不断增长的、嘈杂的记忆仍然是有用的，而不是压倒性的。 没有任何一个固定的启发式方法可以实现所有四个目标；正确的记忆操作是任务进度、记忆状态和智能体学习阶段的函数。so that a growing, noisy memory remains useful rather than overwhelming. No single fixed heuristic achieves all four; the right memory operation is a function of task progress, memory state, and the agent’s learning phase.

我们介绍We introduce记忆会议MemCon (内存Mem奥里作为ory as a骗局Controlled Process），一个将内存访问重新表述为trolled Process), a framework that reformulates memory access as a顺序决策问题sequential decision problem. 记忆会议MemCon强制转换内存操作的选择（casts the choice of memory operation (检索Retrieve, 计划注入PlanInject, 重新检索Re-Retrieve, 巩固Consolidate, 忘记Forget, 无操作NoOp) 及其参数 () together with its parameters (前k个top_k, 洞察_kinsight_k，图, graph跳hop) 作为 a 中的动作) as actions in a内存MDPMemory MDP，其状态捕获任务进度（目标类型、步骤阶段、卡住指示器、访问的位置）和内存状态（大小、计划可用性、学习阶段）。, whose state captures both task progress (goal type, step phase, stuck indicator, locations visited) and memory status (size, plan availability, learning phase).记忆会议MemCon在部署期间，使用带有 UCB 探索的轻量级表格上下文强盗在线学习此 MDP 的策略learns a policy over this MDP online, during deployment, using a lightweight tabular contextual bandit with UCB exploration[2, 22, 44]。该策略是从人类可读的先验中热启动的，通过二进制任务成功的反向折扣信用分配进行更新，并在任务之间保留到磁盘。至关重要的是，. The policy is warm-started from human-readable priors, updated via reverse-discounted credit assignment from binary task success, and persists to disk between tasks. Crucially,记忆会议MemCon添加adds零额外的法学硕士呼叫zero additional LLM calls：内存控制是毫秒级的表查找，而不是第二次 LLM 调用。: memory control is a millisecond-scale table lookup, not a second LLM invocation.

记忆会议MemCon不是一个新的内存存储。它是一个拦截抽象的薄包装器is not a new memory store. It is a thin wrapper that intercepts the abstract检索retrieve和and商店store任何的入口点entry points of any现有的existing内存后端并决定如何调用它们。相同的包装器不变地适用于平面矢量存储、技能库memory backend and decides how to call them. The same wrapper applies unchanged to flat vector stores, skill libraries[47], 基于概括的记忆, summarisation-based memories[64], 潜在标记记忆, latent-token memories[34]，和图结构记忆, and graph-structured memories[60], 干净地分离, cleanly separating什么what存储（后端）自is stored (backend) from如何how它被访问（控制器）并让任何未来的内存系统插入并继承自适应控制。it is accessed (controller) and letting any future memory system plug in and inherit adaptive control.

我们评估We evaluate记忆会议MemCon跨越 6 个基准，涵盖交互式决策（ALFWorldacross 6 benchmarks covering both interactive decision-making (ALFWorld[42], PDDL 规划, ScienceWorld, PDDL planning, ScienceWorld[49]）和知识/网络/工具使用QA（TriviaQA) and knowledge / web / tool-use QA (TriviaQA[17], WebWalkerQA [54], 盖亚, GAIA[32]）； 3 个代理框架（Lobster、LangGraph); 3 agent frameworks (Lobster, LangGraph[3]，微软代理框架）； 3 个 LLM 主干（GPT-4.1-mini、Claude Sonnet-4、DeepSeek-V3.2）；并与跨向量检索的 9 个强记忆基线进行比较 (MetaGPT, Microsoft Agent-Framework); 3 LLM backbones (GPT-4.1-mini, Claude Sonnet-4, DeepSeek-V3.2); and compare against 9 strong memory baselines spanning vector retrieval (MetaGPT[15], 内存库, MemoryBank[64]）、技能库（Voyager), skill libraries (Voyager[47])、轨迹总结(ChatDev), trajectory summarization (ChatDev[37]）、生成式重排序（Generative), generative re-ranking (Generative[36]、ExperienceBank）、基于洞察的学习（OAgents, ExperienceBank), insight-based learning (OAgents[38]）、基于图的分层内存（G-Memory), graph-based hierarchical memory (G-Memory[60]）和潜在令牌内存（LatentMem), and latent-token memory (LatentMem[34]）。 在所有配置中，). Across all configurations,记忆会议MemCon取得最佳或接近最佳的任务成功——例如，achieves the best or near-best task success—e.g.,67.9%67.9\%GPT-4.1-mini（龙虾）上的 ALFWorld，在该单元中评估的所有 10 个记忆中得分最高，并且始终提供 5-ALFWorld on GPT-4.1-mini (Lobster), the top score among all 10 memories evaluated in that cell—and consistently delivers 5–3030与无内存基准相比，增加了 + 点，同时将每个任务的平均令牌消耗减少了 5-20%。+ point gains over the no-memory baseline, while simultaneously reducing average token consumption per task by 5–20%.

2 相关工作Related Work

记忆会议MemCon建立在三个工作基础之上：(i) 多智能体强化学习，(ii) 多智能体 LLM 系统，以及 (iii) 智能记忆。builds on three lines of work: (i) multi-agent reinforcement learning, (ii) multi-agent LLM systems, and (iii) agentic memory.

记忆和工具的强化学习。Reinforcement Learning for Memory and Tools.

Closer to our setting, several recent works learn内存管理memory-management使用深度 RL 或 LLM 驱动控制器的 LLM 代理策略policies for LLM agents using deep RL or LLM-driven controllers[35];我们在一个轻量级的机制中运行，将内存操作视为单代理上下文强盗的行为; we operate in a much lighter-weight regime, treating memory operations as actions of a single-agent contextual bandit[2, 22, 19]（表格 Q 学习的一个特例(a special case of tabular Q-learning[51, 44]）以及剧集级别的蒙特卡洛更新。生成的 MDP 足够小，无需 GPU 也无需二次 LLM 调用即可在线学习。) with episode-level Monte-Carlo updates. The resulting MDP is small enough to be learnable online without GPUs and without secondary LLM calls.

基于角色的法学硕士协作（AutoGenRole-based LLM collaboration (AutoGen[55], 骆驼, CAMEL[21], 元GPT, MetaGPT[15], 聊天开发, ChatDev[37], 特工宇宙, AgentVerse[4]），多主体辩论), multi-agent debate[7, 23]，以及心智社会的表述, and society-of-minds formulations[65, 12]改进单代理基线的推理，而最近的工作优化了协作图本身improve reasoning over single-agent baselines, while more recent work optimizes the collaboration graph itself[26, 66]; LangGraph 等生产框架; production frameworks such as LangGraph[3]Microsoft Agent-Framework 提供我们评估的执行基础；看到and Microsoft Agent-Framework supply the execution substrates we evaluate; see[11, 45]用于调查。这些系统将跨任务学习委托给具有固定检索参数的外部存储器。for surveys. These systems delegate cross-task learning to an external memory with fixed retrieval parameters.记忆会议MemCon坐sits里面inside该内存模块，因此它与单代理（Lobster）、图（LangGraph）和管道（Agent-FW）编排保持不变。that memory module, so it is compatible with single-agent (Lobster), graph (LangGraph), and pipeline (Agent-FW) orchestration unchanged.

对存储的经验进行检索是主导范式。内存流、长期存储和操作系统风格的分页：生成代理Retrieval over stored experience is the dominant paradigm. Most of these systems access memory with fixed顶部top-kk、跳跃、查询和合并时间表；值得注意的例外是 MemGPT, hop, query, and consolidation schedule; the notable exception is MemGPT[35]，这通过将 LLM 本身提升为控制器的角色来使访问模式具有适应性，但代价是每个内存操作需要额外的 LLM 调用。, which makes the access pattern adaptive by promoting the LLM itself to the role of controller, at the cost of additional LLM calls per memory operation.记忆会议MemCon与两种样式正交：它添加了is orthogonal to both styles: it adds a学习但轻量级learned-but-lightweight任何后端之上的控制器 - 决定执行哪个操作、使用什么参数以及何时执行 - 无需任何辅助 LLM 调用。controller on top of any backend—deciding which operation, with what parameters, and when—without any secondary LLM calls.

3 方法Method

3.1 问题表述：内存 MDPProblem Formulation: Memory MDP

考虑一个 LLM 代理解决任务Consider an LLM agent solving tasks{τ1,…,τN}\{\tau_{1},\ldots,\tau_{N}\}依次。在每个任务中sequentially. At each taskτi\tau_{i}，代理与环境交互, the agent interacts with an environment overTiT_{i}访问内存系统的步骤steps with access to a memory systemℳ\mathcal{M}（该(the后端backend）。大多数现有的内存后端公开两个抽象端点，一个). Most existing memory backends expose two abstract endpoints, a检索retrieve调用（返回至call (return up toKK与查询相关的项目）和items relevant to a query) and a商店store调用（写入刚刚完成的任务的轨迹），以及用于合并和驱逐的可选维护挂钩。在标准用法中，这些端点通过硬编码的超参数（项目数量、搜索深度、查询模板、整合计划）进行调用；相反，我们将选择调用哪个端点以及使用哪些参数建模为 MDP 捕获的顺序决策问题call (write the trajectory of the just-finished task), together with optional maintenance hooks for consolidation and eviction. In standard usage these endpoints are invoked with hard-coded hyperparameters (number of items, search depth, query template, consolidation schedule); we instead model the choice of which endpoint to invoke and with what parameters as a sequential decision problem captured by an MDPℳmem=(𝒮,𝒜,𝒯,ℛ,γ)\mathcal{M}_{\text{mem}}=(\mathcal{S},\mathcal{A},\mathcal{T},\mathcal{R},\gamma).

3.3 与后端无关的包装器和增强操作Backend-Agnostic Wrapper and Augmented Operations

记忆会议MemCon周围有一层薄薄的包装纸is a thin wrapper around任何any内存后端memory backendℳinner\mathcal{M}_{\text{inner}}公开了两个方法的接口：that exposes a two-method interface:检索retrieve（返回(returnKK查询项目）和items for a query) and商店store（写出完成的轨迹及其成功标签）；一个可选的(write the finished trajectory with its success label); an optional维持maintainhook 会解锁合并和逐出操作，否则不会进行任何操作。开hook unlocks the consolidation and eviction actions, and is silently no-op’d otherwise. On检索retrieve，包装器构建, the wrapper buildssts_{t}，调用策略来选择, invokes the policy to pick(op∗,θ∗)(\texttt{op}^{*},\theta^{*}), 调用, callsℳinner\mathcal{M}_{\text{inner}}使用这些参数（不支持的参数将被删除），并可选择使用两个与域无关的增强操作之一来增强结果（如下所述）；上with those parameters (unsupported parameters are dropped), and optionally augments the result with one of two domain-agnostic augmented operations (described below); on商店store，它计算剧集奖励，通过方程更新 Q 值。 （, it computes the episode reward, updates Q-values via Eq. (25），更新计划索引，并将持久性委托给), updates the plan index, and delegates persistence toℳinner\mathcal{M}_{\text{inner}}。因为包装器从不读取或改变后端的内部数据结构，所以它真正与后端无关，并且不变地应用于平面向量存储. Because the wrapper never reads or mutates the backend’s internal data structures, it is genuinely backend-agnostic and applies unchanged to flat vector stores[15, 64]、技能库, skill libraries[47], 基于概括的记忆, summarisation-based memories[37], 潜在标记记忆, latent-token memories[34]，和图结构记忆, and graph-structured memories[60]。这两个增强操作针对的是长期交互式任务中的故障模式：. The two augmented operations target failure modes in long-horizon interactive tasks:广义计划注入generalised plan injection（可学习的 MDP 操作，(a learnable MDP action,计划注入PlanInject) 提取类型成功任务的动作序列) extracts the action sequence of a successful task of typegg，替换特定于实例的标识符（例如, replaces instance-specific identifiers (e.g.''货架 3''‘‘shelf 3’’ →\to [货架][shelf]）通过正则表达式重写器，将生成的模板存储在) via a regex rewriter, stores the resulting template undergg在轻量级 JSON 索引中，以及未来类型的任务in a lightweight JSON index, and on future tasks of typegg将模板添加到后端的检索输出中（重写器在新词汇表上降级为同一性）；prepends the template to the backend’s retrieval output (the rewriter degrades to identity on new vocabularies);目标分解goal decomposition（确定性启发式，(a deterministic heuristic,不notMDP 操作）通过注入“首先完成对象 1 的所有步骤，然后重复对象 2”并在存在单对象模板时另外检索单对象模板，来处理需要两个对象使用相同原语两次的复合任务（例如，“将两部手机放在桌子上”）。两种增强仅消耗动作记录并将文本连接到检索到的上下文，因此它们独立于后端；组件消融（§an MDP action) handles composite tasks requiring the same primitive twice with two objects (e.g., “put two cellphones on the desk”) by injecting “complete all steps for object 1 first, then repeat for object 2” and additionally retrieving the single-object template when one exists. Both augmentations consume only the action transcript and concatenate text to the retrieved context, so they are independent of the backend; the component ablation (§4.3, 表, Table4.2）表明仅学习到的控制器就已经占了大部分) shows that the learned controller alone already accounts for the majority of记忆会议MemCon的增益，使得这两种增强都有用但可选。’s gains, making both augmentations useful but optional.

4.3 消融Ablation

我们探讨两个问题： (i) 有多敏感We probe two questions: (i) how sensitive is记忆会议MemCon每个策略超参数，以及 (二) 多少to each policy hyperparameter, and (ii) how much of记忆会议MemCon相对于底层静态管道后端的优势来自于’s gain over the underlying static-pipeline backend comes from the学习控制器learned controller与§的两个增强内存操作相比versus the two augmented memory operations of §3.3？ 我们用单旋钮扫描来回答（i）（图? We answer (i) with a single-knob sweep (Figures4.2–5）和（ii）采用四行元件消融（表) and (ii) with a four-row component ablation (Table4.2).

组件消融（表The component ablation (Table4.2）解决了早期评论中标记的一个混淆：GPT-4.1-mini Lobster-ALFWorld 相对于静态管道后端的大部分增益可归因于) addresses a confound flagged in earlier reviews: most of the GPT-4.1-mini Lobster-ALFWorld gain over the static-pipeline backend is attributable to the学习UCB控制器learned UCB controller (+5.2+5.2S/A）而不是两个增强操作（S/A) rather than to the two augmented operations (+1.5+1.5每个）。在 GAIA 上，它不包含目标分解形式的复合目标，只有学习控制器做出贡献（each). On GAIA, which contains no composite goals of the form targeted by goal decomposition, only the learned controller contributes (+1.2+1.2S/A）；增强的行动并没有增加准确性，因为他们根本没有机会开火。这证实了中心方法论的贡献（学习何时检索、检索什么以及检索多少）是经验收益的主要来源，并且增强操作是有用的但可选的附加组件，其好处仅限于具有结构化复合目标的环境。S/A); the augmented operations add no accuracy because they simply have no opportunity to fire. This confirms that the central methodological contribution (learning when, what, and how much to retrieve) is the dominant source of the empirical gains, and that the augmented operations are useful but optional add-ons whose benefit is restricted to environments with structured composite goals.

5 结论Conclusion

我们介绍了We introduced记忆会议MemCon，一个与后端无关的框架，它不将代理内存视为固定的检索管道，而是将其视为受控决策过程。通过将内存操作建模为内存 MDP 中的操作并学习轻量级在线 UCB 策略，, a backend-agnostic framework that treats agent memory not as a fixed retrieval pipeline, but as a controlled decision process. By modeling memory operations as actions in a Memory MDP and learning a lightweight online UCB policy,记忆会议MemCon自适应地决定何时检索、重用计划、重新检索、合并或跳过内存访问，无需预训练或额外的 LLM 调用。在交互式、QA、网络和工具使用基准测试中，adaptively decides when to retrieve, reuse plans, re-retrieve, consolidate, or skip memory access without requiring pretraining or additional LLM calls. Across interactive, QA, web, and tool-use benchmarks,记忆会议MemCon持续提高跨多个代理框架和 LLM 主干的任务成功率，同时减少代币消耗。这些结果表明，LLM 代理的有效长期记忆不仅取决于存储的内容，还取决于学习如何随着时间的推移访问和管理记忆。consistently improves task success across multiple agent frameworks and LLM backbones while also reducing token consumption. These results suggest that effective long-term memory for LLM agents depends not only on what is stored, but also on learning how memory should be accessed and managed over time.

A.1 基准测试Benchmarks

交互式决策（长期、多步骤）。Interactive decision-making (long-horizon, multi-step).

阿尔夫世界ALFWorld [42]包含 6 种类型的 134 项家务任务（contains 134 household tasks across 6 types (放置、清洁、加热、冷却、检查、放置put, clean, heat, cool, examine, puttwo）；它将 TextWorld 前端与具体的 AI2-THOR 后端结合起来。); it couples a TextWorld front-end with embodied AI2-THOR back-ends.PDDL规划PDDL Planning包含 100 个经典规划任务，涵盖consists of 100 classical planning tasks spanning块世界、酒保、抓手、轮胎世界blocksworld, barman, gripper, tyreworld，与 PlanBench 密切相关, closely related to PlanBench[46, 24, 13]. 科学世界ScienceWorld [49]包含 100 个基础科学实验任务（烧水、融化冰、根据属性寻找动物等）。contains 100 elementary-science experimental tasks (boiling water, melting ice, finding animals by property, etc.).

知识/网络/工具使用质量检查。Knowledge / web / tool-use QA.

问答问答TriviaQA [17]（200 个问题，简答开放域 QA）；(200 questions, short-answer open-domain QA);WebWalkerQA [54]（200个需要站点导航和信息提取的多跳网络遍历问题）；(200 multi-hop web traversal questions requiring site navigation and information extraction);盖亚GAIA [32]（165 个一般人工智能辅助问题，涵盖工具使用、网络搜索和文档阅读）。(165 general-AI-assistant questions spanning tool use, web search, and document reading).

A.2 代理框架Agent Frameworks

我们使用三个架构上不同的代理运行程序，每个代理运行程序共享相同的任务加载器、工具和评估协议，因此跨基线的唯一变化因素是内存系统：We use three architecturally distinct agent runners, each sharing identical task loaders, tools, and evaluation protocol so that the only varying factor across baselines is the memory system:龙虾Lobster，一个单代理极简运行程序，可直接与 OpenAI 兼容的聊天 API 对话；, a single-agent minimalist runner that talks to the OpenAI-compatible chat API directly;郎图LangGraph [3]，基于LangChain构建的图结构多智能体工作流程； 和, a graph-structured multi-agent workflow built on LangChain; andMicrosoft代理框架Microsoft Agent-Framework，一个基于管道的多代理系统。所有实验都使用 30 步的交互任务范围和 QA 基准默认预算，并在内存基线上使用相同的温度和工具协议。, a pipeline-based multi-agent system. All experiments use a 30-step horizon for interactive tasks and the benchmark-default budget for QA, with the same temperature and tool protocol across memory baselines.

A.3 内存基线Memory Baselines

超越无记忆消融（Beyond the no-memory ablation (空Empty），我们与在共享两种方法（检索/存储）接口上重新实现的九个内存系统进行比较，以便差异纯粹是算法上的，而不是由于提示或 I/O 变化造成的： (1)), we compare against nine memory systems re-implemented on a shared two-method (retrieve/store) interface so that differences are purely algorithmic rather than due to prompt or I/O variation: (1)元GPTMetaGPT [15]：对存储的轨迹进行纯矢量相似性检索，检索时没有 LLM 调用； (2): pure vector similarity retrieval over stored trajectories, no LLM calls at retrieval time; (2)航行者号Voyager [47]：LLM 在存储之前总结每个轨迹，通过总结嵌入的余弦相似性检索； (3): LLM summarises each trajectory before storage, retrieval by cosine similarity over summarised embeddings; (3)生成式Generative [36]：检索候选轨迹并使用法学硕士根据估计的相关性对它们重新排名； (4): retrieves candidate trajectories and uses an LLM to re-rank them by estimated relevance; (4)聊天开发ChatDev [37]：每 10 个步骤定期进行 LLM 驱动的基于阶段的总结；无跨任务检索； (5): periodic LLM-driven phase-based summarisation every 10 steps; no cross-task retrieval; (5)记忆库MemoryBank [64]：在向量检索之上具有艾宾浩斯式指数遗忘的时间衰减记忆； (6): temporal-decay memory with Ebbinghaus-style exponential forgetting on top of vector retrieval; (6)OA代理OAgents [38]：基于洞察的学习，比较成对的成功/失败试验，以提炼和编辑自然语言规则； (7): insight-based learning that compares paired successful/failed trials to distil and edit natural-language rules; (7)体验银行ExperienceBank：法学硕士评分的相关性检索，并在显式经验库上进行生成重新排序: LLM-scored relevance retrieval with generative re-ranking over an explicit experience bank[29, 63]; (8) 潜在记忆LatentMem [34]：将跨任务经验提炼成一小部分可学习的潜在标记，并与基于图形的检索前端和 LatentMem 特定的洞察提示配对； (9): distils cross-task experience into a small bank of learnable latent tokens, paired with a graph-based retrieval front-end and LatentMem-specific insight prompts; (9)G记忆G-Memory [60]：结合向量检索的图结构存储器、任务图: a graph-structured memory combining vector retrieval, a task graph withkk-hop 遍历，并通过定期 LLM 驱动的合并对洞察规则进行评分。-hop traversal, and scored insight rules with periodic LLM-driven merge.

对于我们报道的For our reported记忆会议MemCon我们将包装器插入一个特定的后端（G-Memory），以便每个numbers we plug the wrapper into one specific backend (G-Memory) so that every记忆会议MemCon– 基线比较固定在内存储层；因为包装器与后端无关（§–baseline comparison is held fixed at the inner storage layer; because the wrapper is backend-agnostic (§3.3），它同样可以与其他八个中的任何一个组成，并且我们期望定性趋势（控制器以零 LLM 成本增加适应性）转移。), it could equally be composed with any of the other eight, and we expect the qualitative trend (controller adds adaptivity at zero LLM cost) to transfer.

的The记忆会议MemCon包装器永远不会添加第二个 LLM 调用，因此它仅将两种类型的字符串注入到检索到的上下文中。wrapper never adds a second LLM call, so it injects only two types of strings into the retrieved context.

广义计划注入。Generalized plan injection.


这里，每个步骤都是通过概括成功的轨迹来生成的：编号的位置和对象实例被替换为分类占位符（例如，Here each step is produced by generalizing a successful trajectory: numbered location and object instances are replaced with categorical placeholders (e.g.,“去3号架子”"go to shelf 3" →\to “前往[货架]”"go to [shelf]", “从餐桌 2 上拿走杯子 1”"take mug 1 from diningtable 2" →\to “从[餐桌]拿走[杯子]”"take [mug] from [diningtable]"）。正则表达式重写器涵盖标准 ALFWorld/ScienceWorld 词汇（架子、柜子、抽屉、容器、常见食物、工具等）。). The regular-expression rewriter covers the standard ALFWorld/ScienceWorld vocabulary (shelves, cabinets, drawers, containers, common foods, tools, etc.).

E.3 基线内存模块提示Baseline Memory-Module Prompts

OAgents 规则归纳。OAgents rule induction.


G-Memory / LatentMem。G-Memory / LatentMem.

两者都使用两阶段管道：特定于 LatentMem 的洞察提取提示（每种方法不同，但结构上与 OAgents 规则归纳提示相似）加上原始轨迹嵌入的色度向量检索。确切的字符串很长，并且逐字存在于引用的上游存储库中；我们不会在这里重现它们，但请注意它们与中使用的相同Both use a two-stage pipeline: a LatentMem-specific insight extraction prompt (distinct per method but structurally similar to the OAgents rule-induction prompt) plus Chroma-vector retrieval over raw trajectory embeddings.
